scope: Seven bounded direct source handoffs; no cross-owner acceptance

consumers.meaning: Bucket dirty start decrements for equal prior lower timestamp or same main bucket, independently except TF1 alias. _delta reports exclusive settled counts max(0,len-1). New price keys, suffixes and last time published before inner try; only exceptions inside protected yield restore prior suffixes/time and remove new keys. Not blanket rollback of early assignments.

Native live view mutates candle suffix before choosing new index or refreshing retained index. Missing index starts at zero; capacity overflow rebuilds with history enabled. TF1 aliases main/lower, otherwise independent main update. No internal rollback in _update_series.

Outer protected append wraps stage_append and calculation/notification; exception discards retained market view object and reraises. Admission and initial progress outside protected try; no guarantee externally held old references restored.

Window slices times and aliases flattened base offset. First query clamps local range and translates hit position; extrema rejects invalid half-open local bounds. No local validation of base bounds or returned position beyond native contract.

Segment validates main interval, derives lower slice by first and stop main time, conditionally reindexes row objects; prepared windows registered with exact segment sequence references. Constructor receives indexes only on indexed route. Window snapshot of times and live base lifetime not interchangeable with native full index.

Reflected candle view holds source and fixed-size lazy mirror cache; global identity lookup retains object references. Bearish reference replaces candle/seconds views and lower index wrapper after constructing BullishDetector with original data. Reflected index delegates without rebuild; cache cleanup not external-reference rollback.
Actual live crossing capacity constant 16384; module sequence-time registry is separate from index and reflected-view registries.

remaining: Verify all direct and conditional consumers, retained regimes, lifetime and cleanup, dirty frontiers and errors in B02 remaining sections and B09/B10; no runtime.
